Bundling note:
This folder contains the official VB-Audio package contents, extracted without
modifying driver binaries. The bundled installer must keep VB-Audio attribution
and donationware/licensing notice visible. The included VB-Audio readme states
that integrating the package into another software installation procedure
requires author agreement. Do not ship the bundled-driver installer publicly or
commercially until that agreement is in place.
